aggregation_stories.title: Warren Buffett Is Stepping Down as Chairman. Here's How Much You'd Have If You Invested $1,000 In 1970 When He First Took The Role

His son, Howard Buffett, is set to succeed him as chairman, marking the end of a remarkable compounding era.
